Work the pumps.

Swap two horizontal neighbors. Match three or more identical symbols across or down. Pieces refill from below.

Every clear does repair work and lowers the water. Clear multiple lines at once for more work. Refilled cascades earn a smaller bonus. Finish the work target before the water reaches 100%.

Finish jobs for coins and experience. Rank unlocks tougher jobs and more patterns. Spend coins on stronger pumps or better hull seals. Choose a character before taking a job; their specialty applies for the whole job.

Emergency pump: removes 25% water. It starts ready and recharges through swaps that clear pieces. Water rises only during active play. Pause or switch apps to stop it.

Special pieces: pufferfish clear their neighbors; jellyfish clear all pieces of one pattern; crabs cannot swap and must rise above the water. Blasting a crab earns no release bonus.

Full screen fills your browser window. Hiding browser controls depends on your browser’s full-screen support. Progress is saved on this device; your previous story save is kept separately.
